title: The Dog That Knew the Road
description: A wounded dog appears on the Wolfpine Road at dawn, then limps back toward the pines as if trying to lead wiser creatures to something they missed.

not_started.summary: The party has not noticed the wounded dog on the road.

accepted.summary: The party chose to follow the wounded dog.

found_blood_marker.summary: The dog led the party to blood on the roadside stones and a torn strip of caravan cloth.

found_master.summary: The party found the person the dog was trying to reach.

saved_survivor.summary: The party saved the dog's surviving master.

buried_master.summary: The party buried the dog's dead master and ended its vigil.

resolved.summary: The dog's road vigil has ended.
